title: Generative AI for Managers & CEOs
overview: This course is designed for business leaders, executives, and managers who want to understand how Generative AI can transform their businesses, improve decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and drive innovation.
audience: Managers looking to integrate AI into operations
methodology: This course follows a strategic and hands-on approach, including:
Live demonstrations of AI-driven business applications
Capstone project: Developing an AI roadmap for business transformation
competencies: By the end of the course, participants will:
Understand the fundamentals of Generative AI and its business impact
Learn how to integrate AI into business strategies and decision-making
Identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and efficiency
Mitigate risks and ethical challenges associated with AI adoption
Develop an AI strategy for their organization’s growth
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will:
objectives: Develop AI-driven business strategies for growth and innovation
Leverage AI for data-driven decision-making and automation
Identify AI tools to enhance business productivity and efficiency
Understand the risks and ethical implications of AI adoption
Create an actionable AI roadmap for their organization

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Generative AI for Business Leaders

items.text: What is Generative AI, and how does it work?
Understanding AI’s capabilities, limitations, and evolution
AI-driven business model transformation and opportunities
Case studies: How top companies are using AI to gain a competitive edge

outline.title: Module 2: The Strategic Role of AI in Business Transformation

items.text: How AI is reshaping industries and driving digital transformation
AI-driven market analysis, forecasting, and competitive intelligence
The ROI of AI investments – Cost savings vs. revenue growth
Hands-on: Identifying AI opportunities within your organization

outline.title: Module 3: AI for Decision-Making & Business Intelligence

items.text: AI-powered data analytics and predictive insights
Leveraging AI-driven dashboards and reports for strategic decisions
AI in financial forecasting, risk assessment, and scenario planning
Hands-on: Using AI tools for executive decision-making

outline.title: Module 4: AI for Productivity, Automation & Efficiency

items.text: Automating repetitive tasks and workflows with AI
AI-powered virtual assistants for management and operations
AI-driven project management, HR, and supply chain optimization
Hands-on: Exploring AI tools for workplace automation

outline.title: Module 5: AI for Marketing, Sales & Customer Engagement

items.text: AI-driven personalization and targeted marketing
Chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI-powered customer support
AI-enhanced sales forecasting and lead generation
Case Study: How AI is revolutionizing marketing & customer experience

outline.title: Module 6: AI for Innovation & Competitive Advantage

items.text: How AI fosters new product development and service innovation
AI-powered business model innovation and market expansion
Leveraging AI for R&D and intellectual property development
Hands-on: Exploring AI-driven innovation strategies

outline.title: Module 7: AI Ethics, Security & Regulatory Considerations

items.text: The ethical implications of AI in decision-making
AI bias, privacy concerns, and data security risks
Global AI regulations, compliance, and governance frameworks
Hands-on: Developing responsible AI policies for your business
Common roadblocks in AI implementation and how to address them
AI talent acquisition vs. upskilling existing teams
Ensuring AI alignment with company culture and values
Hands-on: Creating an AI adoption strategy for your company

outline.title: Module 9: AI in Mergers, Acquisitions & Investment Strategies

items.text: AI’s role in due diligence, risk assessment, and financial analysis
Leveraging AI for identifying acquisition targets and investment opportunities
AI-powered valuation models and predictive deal success analysis
Case Study: How AI is transforming investment and corporate strategy

extra.title: Prerequisites
items: No prior technical background is required
Basic understanding of business operations and strategy
